ownership_decision.invariant: An evaluation batch compares trials with and without the Skill, and compares two batches, as two separate measurements.

boundary_decision.interaction: None new. The terms name what eval already measures; a Skill withheld Run is still a Run that run executes under its frozen policy.

domain_forces: The contract and code call both the Skill-withheld trials and the earlier batch of a comparison baseline (with_baseline, baseline, baseline_better), so a reader cannot tell which measurement a field belongs to.
The same idea also goes by without_skill, WithoutSkill, skill_withheld and WithholdSkill.
control, the decision's own word for the Skill-withheld trial, already means control plane and UI control in the contract.
implementation_design.decision: Two reviewed terms, Skill withheld and Reference batch, defined by the decision that owns evaluation batches, each listing the names to avoid; the vocabulary-synonyms gate holds today's uses in a baseline that may only shrink, and the renames follow in code.
invariants_preserved: A Skill withheld Run is a Run: the run Context still owns its lifecycle and its frozen policy.
rejected_alternatives: Call the Skill-withheld trial control: control already means control plane and UI control in the contract.
Keep baseline for one of the two: whichever keeps it, readers of the other still guess.
Rename the code first and record the terms later: a rename with no recorded vocabulary has nothing to hold the next author to it.

record.name: Skill withheld
record.definition: A Run that does not load the Skill under evaluation, so it measures the same Test Case without that Skill; an evaluation batch can run one beside every trial and compare the two. Not the same thing as a Reference batch.

record.name: Reference batch
record.definition: The evaluation batch that a comparison of two batches measures against; the other side is the candidate batch. An earlier set of trials, not a Run with the Skill withheld.

approvals.scope: Two evaluation-batch terms, Skill withheld and Reference batch, each with the names to avoid, defined by the decision that owns evaluation batches
